top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Gran Fondo Brasil's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
UCI Gran Fondo Brasil's rolling hills forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 67 miles.
UCI Gran Fondo Brasil's rolling hills rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on rolling hills, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At UCI Gran Fondo Brasil, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Gran Fondo Brasil. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on rolling hills demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
67 miles on rolling hills burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At UCI Gran Fondo Brasil, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on rolling hills. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Low-cadence force work for 3,281ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,281ft of climbing on rolling hills does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for UCI Gran Fondo Brasil’s 67 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at UCI Gran Fondo Brasil. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at UCI Gran Fondo Brasil requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rolling hills to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 67 miles of rolling hills in Timbó, Santa Catarina, Brazil.
